participation.context: Took the thirty-four, and promised nothing unwritten.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted the share, kept last week separate, and shut the book without a total.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Measured thirty-four against thirty-five, and stayed on you.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Took his share, and left the court hours to Kettleby.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Set Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, and set no errand.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

relations.note: the share, with no coffer read out

story.body: You heard the share counted by candle. You did not add it to a coffer. You heard next week's three titles and did not take an errand. You did not promise a line.
